sections.heading: Keep Amplemarket on the shortlist only if…
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Shortlist when Outbound-led B2B teams investing in AI multichannel engagement beat the migration cost. Counter-signal: Drop when Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. outweighs Startup value.

Capability hinge for this product: prospecting; data enrichment; lead management; email sequences.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Gmail.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Startup, Growth, Elite.

sections.heading: Who Amplemarket is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Outbound-led B2B teams investing in AI multichannel engagement.

Avoid if: Buyers needing an affordable CRM.

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Apollo.io on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Amplemarket price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Outbound automation depth vs CRM completeness.

Next step: run prospecting end-to-end, then decide.
